method.advance: At least four additional fresh edits, including both generators and at least three source works; at least two more additions than POS alone; at most two additional fresh original works flagged; at least 36 of 40 edits assessed. Every response contributes zero to authorship confidence.
method.comparison: Use the incumbent point .50 for up to six context windows. Locations require half edited nonspace characters covered and .30 intersection over union. Do not drop unassessed files.
method.head: Fit a regularized, work-balanced direction to differences between paired edited and original target sentences, after subtracting the average feature vector of the two exact adjacent sentences. Compare punctuation, length, and part-of-speech features with a second arm adding labeled attachment shape. At inference, use only the submitted text and pick a unique highest interior sentence.
method.point: For each arm require strictly exceeding the second-highest per-work maximum of 35 dated genuine journal revision pairs. Fit only on 24 retained GAO source works before measuring held features.
method.selection: Twenty previously unused GAO works with matched original and one isolated publisher-labeled polish from each of two generators; require identical flanks in five native sentences. Balance eligible target positions 1, 2 and 3 by fill count with digest tie breaks. Exclude prior or Qwen works and normalized 12-word overlap. Select before extracting parser features.
